mu task close k10 -w eval --evidence 'worker finished k10'; git cherry-pick $(git -C $MU_STATE_DIR/worktrees/eval/w1 rev-parse HEAD); mu agent close w1 -w eval --json | true; mu state -w eval

args.label: course

args.label: course-refute

text: A course check fell due after k10. Two delegates measured and refuted; k11 and k12 break the plan's size limit, so I recorded a human-needed stop before dispatching k11.
